issues.problem: nado-etc explain said the case particle is 'never' before など; に/で/から can precede it (東京になど), only を and が cannot.
issues.action: Reworded: particle normally follows など; を and が never come before it.

issues.problem: nanka-nante explain said なんか replaces が and を, but なんかが is common (私なんかが), and other particles precede it (東京になんか).
issues.action: Rewrote the sentence to give なんかが and に+なんか.

issues.problem: nanka-nante mistake note repeated the over-strong 'replaces を and が' claim.
issues.action: Note now says を never comes in front of なんか; drop it.

issues.problem: Example 田中さん、明日は休むとか言ってたよ reads as addressing Tanaka (vocative), which does not match the English 'Tanaka said...'.
issues.action: Changed to 田中さんは明日休むとか言ってたよ。

issues.problem: Mistake 報告書には売上とか費用とかを書きました is a natural spoken sentence; register is not an error, so the 'bad' sentence was not really wrong.
issues.action: Replaced with a real error: とか in an exact counted list (家族は父とか母とか私の三人です → 父と母と私の三人です).

issues.problem: demo-any explain gave 'question word + も = negative no...' with no exception; applying it mechanically breaks いつも 'always' and どちらも 'both'.
issues.action: Added the いつも / どちらも exception.
